summary: Preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: @servicetitan/anvil2-codemods@0.11.4 declares a preinstall hook ("preinstall": "node setup.mjs") that fires automatically on npm install. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (hex-renamed identifiers _0x488df8=fs, _0x52943e=https, _0x548d91=zlib, with string-property lookup tables referencing /etc/os-release and Alpine detection) and downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, then uses execFileSync on the downloaded Bun binary to run math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated blob using a rotated string-array decoder and hex constant table (// @bun @bun-cjs header, WV8StW string-rotation function, _0x-style identifier renaming). The package's advertised purpose is jscodeshift codemods, which requires neither an alternate JavaScript runtime nor an opaque sibling payload. Running the payload under Bun rather than Node evades Node-focused install-time analysis. The combination of automatic install-time execution, alternate-runtime dropper, and undocumented obfuscated payload matches the install-time supply-chain attack pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
